title: Seismic Design Category C.
officialText:
Where a structure is determined to be in Seismic Design Category C in accor-
dance with Section 1613, the geotechnical investigation shall include an evaluation of the following potential hazards
resulting from earthquake motions: slope instability, liquefaction and surface rupture due to faulting or lateral
spreading. Peak ground acceleration for use in liquefaction analyses shall be determined in accordance with Section
1813.2.1.
